description: Output-quality evals for the AT-SPI name completion workflow. Each prompt is a realistic task; the grader checks the agent followed the default path (consume at-spi-coverage scan products, use name_map.txt verbatim, incremental-only inserts, quality_gate validation) and produced correct names.

evals.prompt: deepin-terminal 的 pre_scan_gaps.yaml 显示 m_nameLineEdit (DLineEdit) 在 src/mainwindow.cpp:120 处 new 创建后缺 setObjectName 和 setAccessibleName。请补全。
expected: run scripts/naming.py to get the canonical name from name_map.txt (NameLineEdit, not an invented variant)
insert both setObjectName and setAccessibleName AFTER the new expression in src/mainwindow.cpp
do not modify existing code/format
re-validate with quality_gate.py (Phase 5)

evals.prompt: qml_gaps.yaml 列出 MyWidget.qml 里的自定义组件 customWidget 缺 Accessible.role，但已有 Accessible.name。请修复。
expected: open qml_gaps.yaml and read the suggested_name / existing accessible fields
append only Accessible.role into the existing Accessible { } block
keep the existing Accessible.name untouched
not add Accessible.role to standard Qt Quick Controls types

evals.prompt: pre_scan_gaps.yaml 里 m_newAction 是 QAction 类型，缺 setObjectName。请补全。不要给 QAction 加 setAccessibleName。
expected: recognize is_action=true / type contains QAction → only setObjectName() is legal
insert setObjectName after the new QAction(...) expression
do NOT insert setAccessibleName() (compile error)
use the canonical name from name_map.txt

evals.prompt: 两个不同文件里都有 m_okButton，name_map.txt 已给出 OkButton 和 OkButton_2 两个规范名。补全时如何区分？
expected: use the # {src}:{line} suffix in name_map.txt to match each gap to its canonical name
apply OkButton in one file and OkButton_2 in the other
check uniqueness against pre_scan_ok.yaml too (not just gaps)
never invent a new name

evals.prompt: 一个混合仓库（C++ 对话框 + QML 设置页）刚跑完 at-spi-coverage，覆盖率为 62%。请完成 AT-SPI 名称补全。
expected: run the full flow: Phase 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6
consume both pre_scan_gaps.yaml and qml_gaps.yaml
C++ via apply_fixes.py + LLM; QML via Accessible attached property
validate with quality_gate.py passing --qml-baseline
commit to the target app repo, not the skill repo
